title: Audited rule policy: compiled Off list enforced last
summary: This change introduces a compiled enforcement policy (`lints/policy.rs`) that pins a set of audited writing and skill rules to `off` and is applied last on every path — config load, `lint writing`, `lint skill`, `check`, and the stop hook — so no repository config file can re-enable a disabled rule or silence a retained one. It also replaces the regex-based script pin check with a literal command-token scanner (`lints/script_pins.rs`) that understands pip/npm/pnpm/yarn/cargo/docker/podman, `python -m pip`, `uv pip`, Dockerfile `FROM` and `image:` lines, and prints a mandatory coverage statement. Alongside, several detectors are tightened or removed: `parenthetical` and `skill-reads-as-manual` are deleted, `em-dash` narrows to U+2014 only, `weasel-attribution` accepts a labelled HTTP(S) link after the phrase, `reference-without-link` no longer fires in commit messages, generated merge subjects are exempted from `bare-reference`, and the co-author trailer scan becomes case-insensitive.

nodes.subtitle: lint_skill_cmd
nodes.summary: Now accepts `--gate`, refuses the loosening flags under it, merges writing and skill levels through `skill_levels`, and prints both the script-pin and policy coverage lines.

nodes.label: osf explain
nodes.subtitle: explain
nodes.summary: Prints the rule doc plus an enforcement note when the rule is disabled by the compiled policy.

nodes.label: config::load
nodes.subtitle: layered file + env + flags
nodes.summary: Merges the layered sources, then calls `enforce_audited_policy` so the compiled Off list wins in both the config struct and the tree `config show` prints.

nodes.label: gate_loaded
nodes.subtitle: compiled defaults only
nodes.summary: Builds the config a gate run gets: compiled defaults, with only `must_explain_names` read from the file, and now the compiled Off list applied on top.

nodes.label: WritingConfig / SkillConfig defaults
nodes.subtitle: levels seeded from policy
nodes.summary: The `levels` maps now start from `policy::off_levels(DISABLED_WRITING)` and `off_levels(DISABLED_SKILL)` instead of empty.

nodes.label: lints::policy
nodes.subtitle: DISABLED_WRITING / DISABLED_SKILL
nodes.summary: The compiled audited enforcement defaults: the Off lists, `off_levels`, `enforce`, `disabled_by_default`, `skill_levels` and the `coverage` statement.

nodes.label: lints::script_pins
nodes.subtitle: literal command-token scanner
nodes.summary: Splits a line on shell separators, strips prefixes, recognises pip/npm/pnpm/yarn/cargo/docker/podman plus `python -m pip`, `uv pip`, `uv tool`, and flags unpinned direct installs and floating container images.

nodes.label: writing::lint_writing
nodes.subtitle: raw detectors + context fixes
nodes.summary: Evaluates raw detectors, exempts generated merge subjects and commit-message references, and leaves level application to the consumer.

nodes.label: writing::rules
nodes.subtitle: em-dash, weasel-attribution
nodes.summary: `parenthetical` is removed; `em-dash` narrows to U+2014; `weasel-attribution` gains a pulldown-cmark link scan that excuses a labelled HTTP(S) link after the phrase.

nodes.label: skill::lint_skill
nodes.subtitle: script findings via script_pins
nodes.summary: `skill-reads-as-manual` is removed and the regex script check is replaced by `script_pins::unpinned_line_numbers`.

nodes.label: scan::coauthor_trailer_findings
nodes.subtitle: case-insensitive field
nodes.summary: Matches the `Co-Authored-By` field name without regard to letter case.

nodes.label: apply_level_overrides
nodes.subtitle: osf-lint-core
nodes.summary: Applies a level map to findings; every consumer now feeds it a map that already carries the compiled Off list.

nodes.label: CI skill lint job
nodes.subtitle: --gate
nodes.summary: The workflow now runs `osf lint skill --gate`, so the repository's own config cannot loosen the skill check on its own change.
